sentences.text:
Shri Aviral Vikas Khare, learned counsel for the appella
 Shri Rajesh Joshi, learned Government A
 respondent/State.

Heard on I.A. Nos.670/2024 & 476/2024, which are applications filed under Section 389(1) of the
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for suspension o f jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of
appellants Rajesh and Mukesh respectively.

2. The appellant-Rajesh has been convicted for offence under Sections 120-B and 420 of I.P.C, 1860
and sentenced to undergo 1 year R.I. for each offence with fine of Rs.1,000/- for each offence and
usual default stipulation and appellant-Mukesh has been convicted for offence under Sections 120-B
and 420 of I.P.C, 1860 and sentenced to undergo 3 years R.I. for each offence with fine of
Rs.2,000/- for each offence and usual default stipulation.
3 .  Learned counsel for the appellants submits that the trial Court has committed error in appreciating the evidence and convicting the appellant.
The co-accused persons Jhitra and Ankit Panchal have already been granted bail and the sentence of the appellants has already been suspended by the trial Court.
There is no likelihood final hearing of this appeal.
Hence, remaining jail sentence of the appellants may be suspended.

4. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of the application for suspension of sentence.
5.
Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, contention of learned counsel for the appellants, without commenting on the merits of the case, the applications is allowed.

6. It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if already not deposited, the appellants shall be released on bail, on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) each with a solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Trial Court,
for their appearance before the Registry of this Court firstly on 22.03.2024 and on such other dates,
Rajesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67669657/
1 as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard, till final disposal of this appeal.
